import hashlib,json,unittest
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/src');f=json.loads((p/'FREEZE.json').read_text());prior=Path('/predecessor')
assert all(hashlib.sha256((p/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for n,h in f['source_sha256'].items())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((prior/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for n,h in f['predecessor_sha256'].items())
r=json.loads((p/'executed/result/RESULT.json').read_text());controls=json.loads((p/'executed/result/controls.json').read_text())
assert r['status']=='HOLD_NOT_REPRODUCED' and len(controls)==13 and all(c['rejected'] is True for c in controls)
for control in controls:
 cell=p/'executed/result'/control['trial']/'record';saved=json.loads((cell/'cell.json').read_text())
 assert all(hashlib.sha256((cell/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for n,h in saved['files_sha256'].items())
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('/src'))
assert result.testsRun==7 and result.wasSuccessful()
print(json.dumps({'source_hashes':8,'predecessor_hashes':60,'controls_raw_hash_sets':13,'methods_passed':7,'saved_successor_reinvocations':0,'native_replays':0,'status':'PASS_RETENTION_ONLY'},sort_keys=True))
